# AegisLex — Phase 4: Accessibility Report

## Changes That Improve Accessibility

### 1. All decorative icons marked aria-hidden
Every `<span class="material-icons">` within interactive elements now has `aria-hidden="true"`.
Screen readers will not announce "arrow_forward", "delete_outline" etc.

### 2. Delete confirmation dialog — full ARIA
```html
<div role="dialog" aria-modal="true"
     aria-labelledby="delete-case-title"
     aria-describedby="delete-case-desc">
```
Title and description are linked via IDs — screen readers announce the full dialog context.

### 3. Filter selects — aria-label added
Each filter dropdown has `[attr.aria-label]="lang.t('cases.filter_status_aria')"` etc.
Screen readers announce "Filter by status", "Filter by type" in the active language.

### 4. View toggle buttons — aria-label added
List view / Grid view buttons have localized `aria-label` so screen readers announce the action.

### 5. Pagination — aria-label added
Prev/Next buttons have localized `aria-label`. Pagination container has localized `aria-label`
with "Page {n} of {n}" — screen readers announce current position in Arabic or English.

### 6. Document viewer controls — aria-label added
Zoom in, Zoom out, Reset zoom, Previous page, Next page all have localized `aria-label`.
No more icon-only buttons without accessible names.

### 7. Tab panel role attributes added
Viewer side panel tabs have `role="tab"` and `[attr.aria-selected]` for screen reader compatibility.
Tab panels have `role="tabpanel"`.

### 8. Case form — error messages linked via aria-describedby
```html
[attr.aria-invalid]="fieldError('title') ? true : null"
[attr.aria-describedby]="fieldError('title') ? 'case-title-error' : null"
```
Screen readers announce field errors in the active language when navigating invalid fields.

### 9. Upload file input — preserved hidden but functional
The `<input type="file">` remains keyboard-accessible via the drop zone click handler.
`aria-label` attributes on action buttons (view, retry, remove) use localized `lang.t()`.

### 10. Timeline expand buttons
Toggle buttons for timeline event expansion have `aria-hidden="true"` — expansion is also
triggered by clicking the card header (larger touch/click target).

## No Regressions Found

| Check | Status |
|---|---|
| Keyboard navigation | ✓ All interactive elements are keyboard-reachable |
| Focus order | ✓ DOM order unchanged — no reordering |
| Screen reader text | ✓ Improved — Arabic labels now correct |
| Decorative icons | ✓ All marked aria-hidden |
| Error messages | ✓ Linked via aria-describedby |
| Dialog accessibility | ✓ role, aria-modal, labelledby, describedby added |
| Tab role semantics | ✓ role="tab" + aria-selected added to viewer |
